# Authoring conventions (shared context for all chain/section docs)

This is a Docusaurus v3 site. Docs live under `website/docs/`. The sidebar is
**autogenerated** from the folder tree; ordering comes from `sidebar_position`
frontmatter and `_category_.json` files (already created — do NOT recreate them).

`routeBasePath` is `/`, so a doc at `website/docs/chains/sui/overview.md` has URL
`/chains/sui/overview`. Use **absolute** site paths in links, e.g. `/developer/rate-limiting`.

## Frontmatter (every doc)

```yaml
---
title: <Human Title>
sidebar_position: <int within its folder>
last_verified: 2026-05-28
---
```

Chain landing/overview docs additionally carry chain metadata mirroring `metadata.yaml`:

```yaml
chain: sui
category: movevm
status: draft
supported_runtimes: [docker, kubernetes, helm, argocd]
developer_interfaces: [grpc, graphql-rpc, json-rpc]
sample_languages: [grpcurl, typescript, graphql]
```

## Style

- Markdown only (`.md`). Real prose + tables + fenced code. No placeholders, no "TODO",
  no "coming soon". Every page must be genuinely useful.
- Use Docusaurus admonitions: `:::info`, `:::note`, `:::warning`, `:::tip`, `:::danger`.
- Code blocks MUST declare a language: ```bash ```json ```yaml ```toml ```ts ```python
  ```graphql ```protobuf.
- Status badges in RPC/API matrices use words: Recommended / Standard / Deprecated /
  Internal / Advanced.
- Cross-link generously to `/developer/*` and `/operations/*` shared docs instead of
  repeating chain-independent material.

## Per-chain document template (folder = chains/<chain>/)

```
overview.md                  (sidebar_position 1) — incl. chain metadata frontmatter
node-architecture.md         (2)
deployment/                  (_category_ pos 3) docker.md, kubernetes.md, helm-values.md, argocd.md
developer-interfaces/        (_category_ pos 4) rpc-api-matrix.md + one md per interface + exposure policy
samples/                     (_category_ pos 5) one md per sample group
operations/                  (_category_ pos 6) initial-sync, snapshot-restore, upgrade-rollback, backup, monitoring, troubleshooting
reference/                   (_category_ pos 7) ports, config-flags, images, resources, official-references
```

## Sample code policy

Samples are realistic, runnable patterns (not toy one-liners): health check, sync-state
query, account/object read, tx query, simulation, submit, event/log query, streaming,
indexer (backfill + live), error handling, production client (reconnect/backoff/metrics).
Show real method names and ports for the chain.

## Accuracy / citations

Cite official docs inline as plain markdown links at the point of claim. Known anchors:
- Ethereum JSON-RPC: https://ethereum.org/developers/docs/apis/json-rpc/
- Geth RPC (ports 8545 HTTP / 8546 WS): https://geth.ethereum.org/docs/interacting-with-geth/rpc
- Beacon API (do not expose publicly): https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs
- Execution APIs: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis
- Sui RPC (JSON-RPC deprecated, migrate by 2026-07): https://docs.sui.io/references/sui-api
- Sui gRPC: https://docs.sui.io/develop/accessing-data/grpc
- Sui Full Node gRPC methods: https://docs.sui.io/references/fullnode-protocol
- Sui GraphQL RPC: https://docs.sui.io/develop/accessing-data/graphql/graphql-rpc
- Sui event indexer example: https://docs.sui.io/getting-started/examples/event-indexer
- Aptos APIs: https://aptos.dev/build/apis
- Aptos REST overview: https://aptos.dev/rest-api
- Solana RPC overview: https://solana.com/docs/rpc
- Solana HTTP methods: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/http
- Solana WebSocket methods: https://solana.com/docs/rpc/websocket
```
